svg.title: A biostatistics toast
svg.desc: An illustrated student tilts her head slightly to the left as she raises a bottle and opens its cap. The cap turns into a coin and drops onto the label, where a rising Poisson cumulative distribution appears while small Ridge, LASSO, normal distribution, and OLS projection diagrams float upward. The animation repeats.

g.text: Waiting and then making progress is Poisson Distribution,
